description:
10 Best Anime With Overpowered & Ruthless Male Leads — these are the most cold-blooded OP protagonists in anime. From Ainz Ooal Gown and Anos Voldigoad to Hajime Nagumo, Touka Mimori and Gabimaru, these overpowered anime main characters don't hold back.

Looking for anime with overpowered male MCs, ruthless protagonists, dark anime, or powerful main characters? This list has some of the most brutal and savage anime MCs you'll find. Some overpowered protagonists become heroes. Others become monsters. This video looks at 10 anime with truly ruthless overpowered male protagonists — characters who don't hesitate to kill, destroy their enemies, or cross the line when pushed too far.

If you enjoy OP anime, ruthless MC anime, dark fantasy anime, overpowered protagonists, anime with no-mercy main characters, isekai anime, and powerful male protagonists, this list is for you.

Which ruthless MC is the most terrifying? Ainz? Touka? Hajime? Anos? Or someone else? Drop your pick in the comments.
title: 10 Anime Where The Trash-Tier MC Returns With ZERO MERCY
